home.speaksAloudOnly: Speaks out loud on this phone. Does not alert staff.

language.toggleHint: Switches the app language and layout direction
language.manualRestartBody: The language was saved, but the screen layout only changes when the app starts fresh. Close it completely, then open it again.

speech.noAlertSent: No alert was sent. Show this screen to a caregiver.
speech.visualFallbackHint: If speech fails, the phrase will appear full-screen.
speech.statusDegraded: The selected voice changed or could not be checked.
speech.iosSilentModeHelp: On iPhone, turn off Silent Mode, raise the volume, and manage voices in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices.
speech.androidVoiceHelp: Check the system text-to-speech engine, installed language data, and media volume.
speech.noVoiceForLanguage: Install a {{language}} voice in device settings.
speech.textTooLong: This message is too long to speak.

myPhrases.title: My phrases
myPhrases.empty: Phrases you use or mark as favorites will appear here for one-tap access.

pin.title: Caregiver access
pin.confirm: Enter the same PIN again to confirm
pin.mismatch: PINs did not match. Start again.
pin.enterCurrent: Enter the current PIN to change it
pin.lockedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
pin.forgotten: Forgot the PIN? Caregiver settings are stored on this device only. Reinstalling the app clears them — along with any custom phrases and photos.

settings.title: Caregiver settings
settings.resetBody: This deletes all custom phrases, favorites, and settings. This cannot be undone.
settings.themeHint: Night suits a darkened bay. High contrast is for low vision.
settings.newPatientHint: Clears the previous patient’s phrases, favourites and history. Keeps the PIN, voices and sound check so the device stays ready.
settings.newPatientBody: Custom phrases, favourites and recent history will be deleted. Device setup is kept.
settings.notANurseCallTitle: This is not a nurse-call system
settings.notANurseCallBody: The red buttons speak a phrase out loud on this device. They do not alert staff, page anyone, or connect to hospital systems. Keep the patient on the ward’s own call system.

editPhrase.deleteConfirmBody: The phrase will be removed from My words.
editPhrase.required: Both languages are required so the phrase works after switching language.
editPhrase.saveFailed: Could not save. Your text is still here — try again.

a11y.emergencyButton: Call the nurse. Emergency button. Speaks immediately.
a11y.breathingEmergencyButton: I can't breathe well. Emergency button. Speaks immediately.

errors.criticalFallback: Something went wrong. These still work.

speechLanguage.title: What the phone says out loud
speechLanguage.hint: The screen stays in the patient’s language. This only changes what is spoken aloud.
speechLanguage.bothHint: Spoken twice, one language after the other. If one voice is missing, the other still speaks.

arabicForm.title: Arabic wording
arabicForm.hint: Arabic changes with who is speaking: “I am tired” is متعب or متعبة. Set the form the patient uses about themselves.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Custom phrases live only on this phone. Export them somewhere safe — a lost or wiped device loses the patient’s own words.
backup.failed: That did not work. Check the file and try again.

readiness.title: Ready for the bedside
readiness.ready: This device is ready for a patient
readiness.manualTitle: Check these yourself — the app cannot see them:
readiness.manualCharger: Plugged in, or a charger at the bedside
readiness.manualSilent: Ringer not on silent, volume up
readiness.manualReach: Phone within the patient’s reach and angle of view
readiness.manualBoard: A printed communication board available as a backup
